units.source_text: 然而，我首先考虑的罪恶，仅仅是如何讨好老师，以便有朝一日掌管金闭，

en.t: Yet the sin I first contemplated was merely how to curry favor with my teacher, so that one day I might take charge of Kinkaku,

units.source_text: 或者仅仅是在幻想中，把老师毒死，然后由我取而代之。

en.t: or merely, in my fantasies, to poison my teacher and then take his place myself.
I was only dreaming foolish dreams.

units.source_text: 我确认鹤川没有和我相同的野心以后，

en.t: After I had confirmed that Tsurukawa did not share the same ambition as I did,

units.source_text: 我甚至感到这项计划使我的良心得到了慰藉。

en.t: I even felt that this plan had brought comfort to my conscience.
